cushion_trials.change_and_result: Low uniform pressure and pressure scale. Footprint depth exceeds the band and side rays miss the folded shell.
Pressure scale 1 stabilizes the shell, but crown and one side bulge are too small.
Bottom anchors and reduced mass. Run ended at frame 19 without a completed saved result.
Pressure 0.04 with bottom anchors. Excess depth, crown and side folding.
Stiffness 200, mass 0.001, pressure scale 0.1. Width and side bulges fail.
Uniform pressure 1 at scale 0.1. Crown is too shallow.
Uniform pressure 5 with the lower-stiffness shell. Run ended at frame 10 without a completed saved result.
Uniform pressure 10. Edge-measurement ray missed the distorted shell after frame 12.
Uniform pressure 0.25. Width, depth, crown and side bulges fail.
Uniform pressure 0.5. Width, height, crown and side bulges fail.
Quality 20, stiffness 500/500/350 and bending 5. Selected; then fitted to nominal seat dimensions.
Pressure 3 with the stiff shell. Height, crown, depth and side bulges exceed their limits.

welt_trials.result: Back pipe chords cut into the compressed return.
Denser vertical samples reduce the back pipe penetration; it remains 0.340 mm over the limit.
All six welts pass the 1 mm surface band and 8 mm diameter gate.

throw_trials.change_and_result: Connected fold, vertical layer offset. Plies overlapped on the vertical hang and expanded outside the envelope.
throw_trials.initialization_defect: Vertical offset is not a normal offset on the hanging section.

throw_trials.change_and_result: Normal-directed layer offset, mass 0.15 and quality 24. Initial back-cushion collision caused displacement.
Moved the sheet forward; initial BVH checks found zero crossings. Coupled tight fold still failed bounds and settling.
Bending 0.005, cap contact pinned, 120 frames. Outside extension 65.447 mm and furniture intersections remain.
Bending 0.005 without pins, 120 frames. Outside extension 105.268 mm and furniture intersections remain.
Quality 30, half-speed integration and collision impulse clamps. Coupled connected fold still expands outside the envelope.
Two separate 0.65 x 1.5 m plies with self-collision and a pinned cap contact strip. Selected. A 2 mm post-thickness lift clears cap-edge triangle crossings.

throw_trials.method: two 0.65 x 1.5 metre plies, lower then upper
throw_trials.change_and_result: Sequential high-resolution plies with 60 percent final decimation. Lower ply settles closer, but upper ply expands outside the envelope.

pilot_assembly.reason: Original cheeks overlapped the seats; original back pads occupied the rear seats. Interior fit surfaces were adjusted to produce nonintersecting cloth parts.

cushion_trials.assessment: Softer shell with pressure 3 overinflated: crown 94.80 mm and side bulges 112.5 to 153.5 mm.
Crown passed after fitting, but three side bulges exceeded 30 mm. Initial assembly and piping also exceeded their limits.
Larger radius at lower pressure still produced irregular shoulders and side bulges above 30 mm.
The thinner coarse shell had shallow crowns and unequal side bulges.
Denser grid reduced shoulder asymmetry. Crown remained below 35 mm.
Higher bending resistance held the crown below 35 mm.
Pressure 3 on the dense shell produced excessive crowns and side bulges.
A taller shell produced a 49.46 mm raw crown but still excessive side bulges.
Inset upper shoulders let the side-wall belly and rounded top edge inflate separately. Fitted crowns, bulges, edge radii, corners and contacts pass.

settings.name: throw-i
settings.fold_method: one continuous thick sheet with a rounded cap roll

throw_trials.assessment: Single gathered sheet passed folds and coverage. One thickness self-crossing remained at the inner rear hem, and motion was 2.785 mm over the last five frames.

settings.name: throw-j
settings.fold_method: one continuous thick sheet with a rounded cap roll

throw_trials.assessment: Longer settle reduced motion to 0.138 mm. One inner-hem crossing remained. Transfer to the inset-shoulder cushions exposed a 0.898 mm contact penetration, so this transferred assembly was rejected.

settings.name: throw-k
settings.fold_method: one continuous thick sheet with a rounded cap roll

throw_trials.assessment: Greater bending resistance and the actual fitted colliders removed crossings, but motion remained 6.348 mm over the last five frames. The inside rear hem started against the back cushion.

settings.name: throw-l
settings.fold_method: one continuous thick sheet with a rounded cap roll

throw_trials.assessment: Moved the sheet forward 65 mm to clear the back cushion and held the 35 mm rolled cap strip. Motion fell to 0.0231 mm. All geometry gates pass after orphan mesh names are cleared. The circle measurement was corrected to use geometric residuals for the two skins of the thick sheet.

aging.result: Free cover edges slipped off the crust. The throw lost 43.91 percent of reference area and the mesh exceeded the triangle cap.
Pinned the cover rims, aligned cover splits with Voronoi cells and reduced the core. Throw loss and triangle count entered their bands; back supports and collisions still failed.
Used a continuous core contact envelope and clearance fitting after simplification. Frays were added before thickness. Back supports and cloth crossings remained.
Reduced back-pad depth with inverse height compensation and gave fibres a thinner section. Longer cloth settling and more self-separation did not remove crossings.

Increased cover resolution and contact clearance, retained more throw cap stitches and raised collision quality to 16. All volume, tear and triangle bands passed. The back pads still floated above the curved deck.

Reused the age-e cloth bake and raycast the actual frame beneath each crust. Back pads moved down 3.491 to 3.514 mm and seats by 0.044 to 0.049 mm. All six support gaps passed. Cloth self-crossings remain.

aging_pass2.method: Direct gravity-shaped surface construction and constrained sewn-pattern deformation; not a new cloth or rigid-body simulation.
